selected_script.angle: Solving the double-hassle of chasing runaway paper towel rolls and digging for cleaning sprays under the sink with an all-in-one heavy-duty matte black holder.
selected_script.hook: Stop chasing your paper towel roll across a messy counter and hunting under the sink for spray.

script_record.pain_point: Knocking over cheap paper towel holders while cooking and searching for a separate spray bottle.
script_record.conflict_hook: Stop chasing your paper towel roll across a messy counter and hunting under the sink for spray.
script_record.product_solution: Ultrean Paper Towel Stand with a 2.65lb weighted base for one-handed tearing and a hidden integrated spray bottle.

timeline.scene: A close-up of sticky hands attempting to tear a sheet from a cheap plastic paper towel holder, causing the entire stand to tip over and slide into a kitchen spill while searching for a spray bottle.
Transition to the sleek matte black Ultrean Paper Towel Stand. A hand easily tears a paper towel sheet one-handed with the heavy stand remaining completely stable.
Close-up of a hand pressing the top one-push lock button on the solid matte black center rod and pulling out the integrated, hidden transparent spray bottle.
Close-up of the user spraying a fine mist directly onto the countertop spill using the extracted spray bottle.
The user wipes the surface clean and slides the spray bottle back into the solid black main sleeve, locking it back in place.
A clean kitchen countertop showing the assembled matte black stand. Text overlay: 'Keep your kitchen clean and clutter-free.'

script_record.cta: Keep your kitchen clean and clutter-free.
